debate.said: Here is the case for owning Commerzbank. Earnings changed +52.5% versus a year ago. Operating margin is 43.1%. It trades at 8.7x forward earnings.
I'm not convinced. Price is 6.9% below its 200-day average: the long-term trend is down. MACD is negative and falling: momentum is deteriorating. Annualised volatility is 34%.
Price action is noise over a few weeks; the business is what we own — earnings changed +52.5% versus a year ago. Weakness can be an entry point.

risk: Maximum position size: 13% of the portfolio (scaled for 34% volatility).
Every order costs a €1 fee, like on Trade Republic. Stop-loss rule: review at -15% from cost.
chair: Weighted committee score is +0.27 on a scale of -1 to +1; 4 of 5 analysts lean the same way. Conviction: Medium.
Decision: BUY. We propose a position of up to 13% of the portfolio.
